_schema_version.description: The latest released dbt charts YAML schema version this file was last migrated to, written by `dct migrate` only -- never hand-author this. Informational: nothing reads it back when your board loads, and it is not a validated guarantee about the file's actual grammar (a hand-edit after migration can make it stale). YAML key: _schema_version.

aliases.description: Additional URLs that redirect to this board's canonical file-path URL. Each entry must be absolute (leading /). Requests to these URLs are redirected (302) to the board's real path, query string preserved. Valid on .yml, .yaml, .md, and folder index.* boards.

cache.description: Cache policy for every query in this dashboard, e.g. cache: 1h: queries inherit it and may refine it; cache: false opts the whole dashboard out. Inheritable via the meta.yml cascade.

card_gap.description: When True, adds gap between cards. Default: cards are edge-to-edge (0 gap).

chart_focus.description: Render only this named chart with its dependent variables (useful for embedding or SVG export).

charts.description: Named chart definitions. When no explicit layout is present, charts render as an implicit row layout in authored order.

cols.description: Horizontal layout: list of chart names or inline chart/board definitions.

details.description: Collapsible section metadata. String shorthand: details: 'text' → BoardDetails(summary='text'). Block form: details: {summary: ..., expanded_title: ..., expanded: false}.

extends.description: Themes or board files to inherit; the last one wins. A bare name is a built-in theme; write `./` before a file path (`./_brand.yml`). One name or a list: `extends: neon`, `extends: [./base.yml, neon]`. The board's own explicit style, a background included, beats every extended theme, so a dark variant of a base that sets a background restates that background in the variant.

grid.description: CSS-grid style layout with explicit row/column placement.

height.description: Height when nested (e.g., '300px' or an integer in pixels).

html_policy.description: HTML rendering policy for the board's body text. Inline nested boards inherit it unless they set their own; tabs always inherit, and imported board files do not. One of: "none" (default): HTML is escaped and rendered as plain markdown; "safe-subset": reserved for a parser-checked allowlist (not yet enforced; currently renders as none); "trusted-raw": raw HTML via foreignObject. TRUSTED-CONTENT ONLY: this is NOT a security sandbox. <script>/event-handlers are stripped as a best-effort guard, not a guarantee. Enable only on first-party boards you fully control.

id.description: Explicit ID for this board. Auto-generated from filename if omitted.

incremental.description: Default watermark column for incremental refresh: queries in this board fetch only new rows since the last run and merge them with the cached result, keyed on this column. Queries inherit this value and may override it with their own incremental: setting. Set to false on a nested board to opt out of a parent's incremental setting.

links.description: Link behavior for the whole board: links.auto adds detail-page links to table charts, links.open sets how links open. Root board only; a nested board's links: is an error.

notes.description: What search finds: say what the board is for and which tables or sources it reads, in a sentence or two, with the other words someone might search for (synonyms of its measures). No dates or "as of".

queries.description: Named result sets the charts draw from.

regional.description: Locale and currency for every number on the board. Set it in charts/meta.yml to cover a folder; a nested board takes its root's.

rows.description: Vertical stack layout: list of chart names or inline chart/board definitions.

source.description: Default source name for all queries in this board. Inheritable via meta.yml cascade.

style.description: Appearance overrides for this board (background, border, and more). Most fields this board or an ancestor board explicitly authors cascade to nested child boards. Per-board fields (margin, padding): a nested board resolves these against its own theme, never an ancestor's. Root-board-only fields (footer, timestamp): a nested board never draws its own footer or timestamp line, so these never reach it either. background is the one appearance field that never cascades: unset means transparent, not an ancestor's color.

tabs.description: Tabbed navigation layout where each tab contains its own layout.

tags.description: Keywords for grouping and searching boards.

text.description: A Markdown block, as Jinja over query results: `{{ queries.totals.one.revenue }}` for a one-row query, `{{ queries.top.rows[0].name }}` for row N. A value prints raw, so format it in SQL; titles and subtitles read the same way.

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the board.

variables.description: Named inputs that parameterize queries; each renders as a control unless it sets visible: false.

visible.description: Controls whether this layout item is rendered. Accepts a bool, variable name, Jinja expression, or {query, column} probe.

width.description: Width when nested (e.g., '50%', '400px', or an integer in pixels). On the root board there is no parent to place it into, so it is the board's own exact width in pixels, even past style.frame.max_width; percentages are rejected there since there's nothing to size relative to. Unset, the root board hugs its content up to style.frame.max_width.
